# Python Standards

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Enterprise Standards](../../README.md) • [Technology Standards](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains Python specific standards for enterprise environments. These standards provide comprehensive guidance for Python application development, including coding conventions, testing methodologies, security scanning, and microservice implementation patterns using modern Python frameworks and tools.

These standards ensure consistent, secure, and scalable Python applications across the platform. They complement the general application standards with Python-specific guidance for:

- Coding conventions and best practices
- Error handling and structured logging
- Linting and code quality configurations
- Microservice implementation patterns
- Security scanning and vulnerability management
- Testing frameworks and quality assurance
